text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are flat over the past day, holding their levels as the market awaits direction. Fear & Greed sits at 34, indicating genuine concern among traders, though the slight 3-point weekly rise suggests some stabilization from deeper lows. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.2% paired with subdued volume of $26B reflects cautious positioning—neither a capitulation flush nor conviction buying, but a market consolidating through uncertainty.
